item.title: BlockBeats｜We're hiring! 🚨 加密市场正在经历全面流动性收缩？头部公链 TVL 近 30 天普遍下跌 15% 至 25% 据 @Defi
item.description:
BlockBeats｜We're hiring!
🚨 加密市场正在经历全面流动性收缩？头部公链 TVL 近 30 天普遍下跌 15% 至 25%

据 @DefiLlama 数据，过去 30 天，几乎所有主流公链的 DeFi TVL 都出现明显缩水：

- Ethereum：-20.10%，剩余 371.76 亿美元
- BSC：-23.17%，剩余 45.16 亿美元
- Bitcoin：-21.62%，剩余 32.47 亿美元
- Tron：-20.02%，剩余 44.57 亿美元
- Solana：-18.08%，剩余 47.80 亿美元
- Base：-15.37%，剩余 51.97 亿美元
- Sui：-25.30%，剩余 3.68 亿美元

这次并不是资金从 Ethereum 流向 Solana，或者从 BSC 流向 Base，而是几乎所有头部生态都在同步缩水。

背后可能有几股力量叠加：BTC、ETH 等资产价格下跌，直接压低美元计价 TVL；ETF 资金流出、杠杆清算及风险偏好下降，促使投资者减少 DeFi 敞口；部分资金则可能转向稳定币或退出链上市场。

但需要区分，TVL 下跌不等于同等规模的真实资金外流。即使链上资产数量不变，币价下跌也会造成 TVL 缩水。

如果稳定币供应、链上资产数量和 DeFi TVL 同时持续下降，就意味着市场面临的不只是估值回调，还有真实流动性收缩。

加密行业未必不行了，但市场可能正在经历一轮残酷的去杠杆和流动性重新定价。下一轮资金回流时，也未必会重新流向所有公链和协议。
tweet

item.title: World of Statistics On average, your friends have more friends than you do. Peop
item.description:
World of Statistics
On average, your friends have more friends than you do.

People with more connections are more likely to appear in someone else’s circle, pulling the average up.

It’s called the friendship paradox – a network effect, not a personality flaw.

item.title: Kay Capital 看到云居民想办美国驾照想过 Claude KYC 的 data point，给一个忠告，有遣返（等遣返飞机期间会关进 detention
item.description:
Kay Capital
看到云居民想办美国驾照想过 Claude KYC 的 data point，给一个忠告，有遣返（等遣返飞机期间会关进 detention center 坐牢）、注销签证风险。

有身边朋友 B1/B2 旅游签抽到小黑屋翻到手机里有换驾照预约被遣返、注销签证的案例。

另外 NJ 在每次大选之前的几个月，会自动注册选民，也有 H1B 工签网友在不知情情况下被注册成选民被遣返的案例。

在目前的 AI 中国间谍叙事下面，如果被 CBP 发现一个中国人 B1/B2 旅游签专程来办驾照，你可能会有些麻烦的。

法律上确实没有说不给非美居民，但驾照在美国几乎等价身份证。体会下 CBP 官员发现你又是办身份证又是开银行账户的感觉。

item.title: 投机实验室 韩国传奇交易员金亨俊，靠交易赚了 150 亿到 200 亿韩元，差不多 1500 万美元，他的方法不是靠别的，就是胜率贼高 😂 🥸 一年两百多个交易
item.description:
投机实验室
韩国传奇交易员金亨俊，靠交易赚了 150 亿到 200 亿韩元，差不多 1500 万美元，他的方法不是靠别的，就是胜率贼高😂🥸

一年两百多个交易日，能让他亏钱的只有二三十天，全职十五年按月算只亏过两个月。

他的打法叫新高法，我把整套策略做成了这一张图。

逻辑是等股票冲上新高，回落一下再买，创了新高，上面就没有被套住等着回本就卖的人了，可新高大多是一根大阳线拉上去的，当天追就是买在最高处。

先选股，他做短线，看当天成交额前 50 名，去掉 ETF，挑跟新题材挂钩的龙头股，创了新高先放进自选，股价还要站上 120 日线。

再等买点，他等的是上升阴线，就是股价往上走的途中收出的阴线，冲上来那段成交额要放到 500 亿韩元以上，阴线收盘还在 5 日线上面，当天还有机构在买，三个条件都对上就在收盘前买进。

第二天开盘一段时间还涨不上去，马上止损。每次买多少按总资金的百分之几先定好，同时只集中在两三只。

涨上去就一直拿着，跌破 5 日线再卖。高位突然放出上涨那几天 5 倍以上的量，就当成真的见顶。

哪几种票要小心，什么时候停手，他做日内的变化，还有 Celltrion 和大韩航空两笔实盘，都在图里。
tweet

item.title: ZachXBT RT @zachxbt : @Anitha_TDP Hello why did Andhra Pradesh law enforcement a
item.description:
ZachXBT
RT @zachxbt: @Anitha_TDP Hello why did Andhra Pradesh law enforcement abuse fake evidence to recently obtain an Indian court order to seize $1.5M from an innocent Chinese investor because the team does not understand basic crypto tracing?

Case reference: Cr. No. 10/2025

Indian law enforcement froze $3M from an innocent Chinese investor after mistaking a crypto bridge for a pig butchering scam. Now an Indian court has ordered Gate to hand his funds to a person they never belonged to.

My analysis of how Indian LE traced through an unlabeled service and wrongly froze @xxxkeym's Gate account:

The case stems from a pig butchering victim who allegedly lost $1.7M of BTC, USDT, DOGE & SOL in May 2025.

Andhra Pradesh CID registered it as Cr. No. 10/2025 and filed a charge sheet in March 2026.

In July 2025, xxxkeym had Gate deposit address 17mpajZ6Nq3dG3T6wUhaXxYF4Qy9HJnYx5 frozen after depositing 15 BTC from 3NcBhqK in the following transaction:
885f3afab562251b222363cf12095e864ddb94636674b01f0cdb05997e5a54a0

This is one transaction Indian LE cites in its notice. 3NcBhqK was funded by xxxkeym's own OKX & Binance withdrawals in Jan 2023 and the coins sat dormant for years until the Gate deposit.

Indian LE never froze his OKX or Binance accounts, the actual source of the 15 BTC, which tells you how flawed their justification is.

Gate froze his entire account, which held roughly $3M at the time and about $1.5M today.

The Indian court order hands all of it to the complainant.

Gate deposit address 17mpajZ also received two deposits for 15 BTC total in 2025 from bc1pkkwqyxn3rm608ryuqg9hyqna0syq4jx5pxkr7pzg8n3usx6tyqfst5u966, which is also controlled by xxxkeym.

Shortly before the deposits to Gate, bc1pkkw was funded in three transactions by bc1quzwkggdf6ly06mrrnnled0qdr57w770k45n5n7 & bc1qtu66zfqxj6pam6e0zunwnggh87f5pjr7vdr5cd.

bc1quzw & bc1qtu66z were reported as alibarbit[.]bit, the same scam named in Indian LE's press release.

That was a mistake. Both belong to the Merlin Chain bridge, which is unlabeled in most compliance tools.

xxxkeym is simply a normal Merlin user trading tokens on the L2. This wrong label is the only place the scam touches his transaction history.

Below is the blockchain data showing each Merlin withdrawal by xxxkeym matched to a BTC payout from those addresses, plus screenshots of the bridge activity.

xxxkeym bridged 50 BTC into Merlin on March 28, 2024, over a year before the alleged May 2025 theft.

His three withdrawals came out of that balance. I found zero onchain connections between xxxkeym and the theft.

Separately on July 15, 2025 xxxkeym had a 7 BTC private key compromise theft which was reported to local police and also SlowMist was engaged. His stolen funds flowed to Wasabi.

This is embarrassing incompetence by Indian LE, who seem incapable of reviewing basic blockchain data.

Indian LE, the prosecutor and the judge all signed off on this, Gate froze the account, and LE did a full press release about it recently, while the real victim here (the Gate user) hasn't had access to his funds for nearly 16 months.

My hot take is VASPs need to challenge weak jurisdictions like India, Canada, etc due to repeated negligence in criminal cases.

item.description:
Eric Xing
Full transparency and reproducibility promised and delivered, not something you can expect from coordinate LLM producers. We stand by LLM360 definition of full openness for people to truly study understand, and use without fear AI.

Looking for a reference manual for building a frontier LLM? We wrote one 👇

The K2 Horizon technical report is now on arXiv: 134 pages on how we built six models, from architecture to inference. It may be the most detailed LLM training reference you can read today.

• Architecture: we bring two new attention designs, MoVA and softplus attention gating, to strengthen reasoning. With them, our 36B model nearly matches a 32B dense one on one-seventh of the active parameters.
• Pre-training: we trained four models, from 3.7B to 36B, on the same 22T tokens. Their normalized loss curves collapse onto nearly the same line, so a recipe that works on a small model carries over when scaling up.
• Data: 60+ pages on the part most reports skip. How we generated ~10T synthetic tokens, and why we chose the data mix on predicted scores at scale, which reversed the small-run ranking.
• Post-training: we document our full production-scale run for the 375B flagship.
• Inference: Uno gives an autoregressive model diffusion speed with one small adapter. Up to 2.2× faster decoding, lossless by construction, no draft model.

This is the last piece of the openness puzzle. K2 Horizon already shipped with 380 checkpoints, 13 TB of pre-training data, 58 training runs and 17 code repositories. The report explains the decisions behind them.

More details: https://t.co/vMmqj2nXiJ - Institute of Foundation Models

item.title: ZachXBT RT @zachxbt : @naralokesh Kindly please explain why Andhra Pradesh law e
item.description:
ZachXBT
RT @zachxbt: @naralokesh Kindly please explain why Andhra Pradesh law enforcement abused fake evidence to obtain an Indian court order to seize $1.5M from an innocent Chinese investor because they do not understand basic crypto tracing?

Case reference: Cr. No. 10/2025

Indian law enforcement froze $3M from an innocent Chinese investor after mistaking a crypto bridge for a pig butchering scam. Now an Indian court has ordered Gate to hand his funds to a person they never belonged to.

My analysis of how Indian LE traced through an unlabeled service and wrongly froze @xxxkeym's Gate account:

The case stems from a pig butchering victim who allegedly lost $1.7M of BTC, USDT, DOGE & SOL in May 2025.

Andhra Pradesh CID registered it as Cr. No. 10/2025 and filed a charge sheet in March 2026.

In July 2025, xxxkeym had Gate deposit address 17mpajZ6Nq3dG3T6wUhaXxYF4Qy9HJnYx5 frozen after depositing 15 BTC from 3NcBhqK in the following transaction:
885f3afab562251b222363cf12095e864ddb94636674b01f0cdb05997e5a54a0

This is one transaction Indian LE cites in its notice. 3NcBhqK was funded by xxxkeym's own OKX & Binance withdrawals in Jan 2023 and the coins sat dormant for years until the Gate deposit.

Indian LE never froze his OKX or Binance accounts, the actual source of the 15 BTC, which tells you how flawed their justification is.

Gate froze his entire account, which held roughly $3M at the time and about $1.5M today.

The Indian court order hands all of it to the complainant.

Gate deposit address 17mpajZ also received two deposits for 15 BTC total in 2025 from bc1pkkwqyxn3rm608ryuqg9hyqna0syq4jx5pxkr7pzg8n3usx6tyqfst5u966, which is also controlled by xxxkeym.

Shortly before the deposits to Gate, bc1pkkw was funded in three transactions by bc1quzwkggdf6ly06mrrnnled0qdr57w770k45n5n7 & bc1qtu66zfqxj6pam6e0zunwnggh87f5pjr7vdr5cd.

bc1quzw & bc1qtu66z were reported as alibarbit[.]bit, the same scam named in Indian LE's press release.

That was a mistake. Both belong to the Merlin Chain bridge, which is unlabeled in most compliance tools.

xxxkeym is simply a normal Merlin user trading tokens on the L2. This wrong label is the only place the scam touches his transaction history.

Below is the blockchain data showing each Merlin withdrawal by xxxkeym matched to a BTC payout from those addresses, plus screenshots of the bridge activity.

xxxkeym bridged 50 BTC into Merlin on March 28, 2024, over a year before the alleged May 2025 theft.

His three withdrawals came out of that balance. I found zero onchain connections between xxxkeym and the theft.

Separately on July 15, 2025 xxxkeym had a 7 BTC private key compromise theft which was reported to local police and also SlowMist was engaged. His stolen funds flowed to Wasabi.

This is embarrassing incompetence by Indian LE, who seem incapable of reviewing basic blockchain data.

Indian LE, the prosecutor and the judge all signed off on this, Gate froze the account, and LE did a full press release about it recently, while the real victim here (the Gate user) hasn't had access to his funds for nearly 16 months.

My hot take is VASPs need to challenge weak jurisdictions like India, Canada, etc due to repeated negligence in criminal cases.

item.title: 梁 自媒体做得还不错的朋友，真心劝你们考虑找一份稳定的工作，把自媒体当成副业来做。 既然有能力把自己的账号做起来，找一份薪资不错的品牌宣传或新媒体运营工作，其实
item.description:
梁
自媒体做得还不错的朋友，真心劝你们考虑找一份稳定的工作，把自媒体当成副业来做。

既然有能力把自己的账号做起来，找一份薪资不错的品牌宣传或新媒体运营工作，其实并不难。

我也是逐渐意识到，自媒体的收入越来越不稳定，才选择进入大公司上班。不仅有一份稳定的工资，工作也相对轻松自在，同时还能继续做自己的账号，保留副业收入。

随着越来越多人开始用AI制作内容，自媒体的竞争只会更加激烈，单靠内容赚钱的空间也会进一步被压缩。

对今后的自媒体人来说，找到一家需要流量、也愿意为你的能力付费的实体企业，把自己的传播能力和实际业务结合起来，或许才是一种更安稳、更长久的生活方式。
tweet

投机实验室
但斌说今年像 1994 年，不像 2000 年😂🥲

我把纳指翻出来对了一下，今年这一轮离 1994 年跌得最深的那个位置，只差 2% 了。

1994 年纳指 3 月见顶，一路跌到 6 月底，最深跌了13.7%，全年收跌 3.2%，第二年涨了四成。

今年是 10 月 6 号见顶，到昨晚正好 6 周跌了 11.9%。

2000 年是 3 月 10 号见顶，同样过了 6 周，纳指已经跌了 28%，到年底直接腰斩，光看跌的速度，今年跟 1994 年是一档的，跟 2000 年差得远。

但 1994 年是全年收阴线的。今年纳指昨晚收 24,328，比去年底还高 4.7%，要收阴线，年底前还得再跌 4.5%。

23800 这条线破了，今年这一跌就比 1994 年最深的时候还深。
